- [FACT] User has a 2018 Honda Civic.

- [EVENT] User is trying to get their car's oil changed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended oil change interval for 2018 Honda Civic with conventional oil is every 5,000 to 7,500 miles under normal conditions and every 3,000 to 5,000 miles under severe conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended oil change interval for 2018 Honda Civic with synthetic oil is every 7,500 to 10,000 miles under normal conditions and every 5,000 to 7,500 miles under severe conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended oil change interval for 2018 Honda Civic with synthetic blend oil is every 5,000 to 7,500 miles under normal conditions and every 3,000 to 5,000 miles under severe conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check their owner's manual or maintenance schedule to see when the last oil change was done.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors affecting oil change interval include driving habits, road conditions, and oil type.
